lessons: Review the exact text that will be committed: inside the review hook, run validate_ticket on the provisional stamp, resolve start_state, apply the final state stamp, then call review_ticket on that final text. Never review the draft-stamped text.

Carry the reviewed final text with its verdict (for example in `reviewed`) and commit those exact bytes. Do not restamp the text after approval, so the journaled ticket_sha matches the committed blob.

Add a test in tests/test_author.py where start_state resolves to a non-draft state (box_policy row such as `confirmed`). Assert that the requisition_verdict ticket_sha equals the sha of `git rev-parse HEAD:<ticket path>` content.

Keep the rest of the already-passing work as it is: the driver hooks, the review keying `llm/author/<pass>/requisition_review/<seq>/<call_seq>`, the rma terminal path and the triage script additions. Change only the stamp ordering and add its test.
